title: Three-Day Agreement
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was pondering Mo Xiansheng's true identity, the urgent knocking at the door ceased abruptly, replaced by a voice all too familiar to him—the Imperial Court emissary's soul fluctuation was remarkably similar to Mo Xiansheng's.

text.content: Blood-red warnings were seared into the sixth page of the Tianji Record—those who continue to investigate shall die. Before Chen Ji could recover from his father's death, urgent knocking came at the door. The rhythm—three long beats followed by two short—was the coded signal he shared with Ye Qing. He took a deep breath, tucked the Tianji Record into his sleeve, and rose to open the door. Standing outside were not only Ye Qing but also his long-missing sister—Chen Nian. Both wore grave expressions. Ye Qing clutched a yellowed talisman paper, its ink still wet. "Brother, Mo Xiansheng's final ultimatum has arrived." Chen Nian's voice trembled slightly. "He said... only three days."

dialogue.content: "Three days? Hmph, that old creature is impatient indeed." Ye Qing coldly handed the talisman paper to Chen Ji, "But his calculations are quite clever—he determined you wouldn't refuse, because refusal means permanent sealing of the Tianji Record." Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji's face, "But he overlooked one thing."

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the talisman paper, his gaze sweeping across the characters. Mo Xiansheng's calligraphy was bold and powerful, each stroke carrying irresistible pressure. Three days. This was the deadline given to Chen Ji. Within three days, either surrender the interpretation rights to the sixth page of the Tianji Record, or accept the consequence of its permanent sealing. Chen Ji folded the paper and tucked it into his sleeve, his expression terrifyingly calm. "He wants more than the Tianji Record." He spoke slowly. "What he truly desires is to make me his complete chess piece—a puppet stripped of self-will."

dialogue.content: "Brother, I have a solution." Chen Nian suddenly spoke, her voice soft yet carrying an air of resolve. "What Mo Xiansheng truly desires isn't the Tianji Record, but me. Because I am the Heavenly Fate Key, my existence can disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight." She lifted her head, meeting Chen Ji's gaze directly. "If I step forward willingly, negotiating as the Heavenly Fate Key..."

text.content: "No." Chen Ji interrupted almost the instant she finished speaking, his tone unusually harsh. "Do you understand what being the Heavenly Fate Key means? Once your identity is revealed, the entire Holy Sect will view you as prey to be captured." His eyes darkened. "I won't let you take this risk." Chen Nian opened her mouth to retort, but Ye Qing raised her hand to stop her.

dialogue.content: "Don't rush to conclusions, Chen Ji." Ye Qing walked past Chen Ji to the window, turning her back to both of them. "Your sister's proposal, while risky, isn't without merit. Mo Xiansheng desires control, and your sister's unique constitution can precisely break that control—the Heavenly Fate Key can cause deviations in the Tianji Record's foresight, meaning he cannot fully dominate your fate." She turned around. "My suggestion: pretend to agree with him. Surrender some authority on the surface, but in reality... we build our own foundation."

choice.prompt: Confronted with Mo Xiansheng's final ultimatum, Chen Ji must make a choice. Does he accept Ye Qing's proposal to feign compliance, or seek another way?

choices.description: Appear to comply with Mo Xiansheng's demands while covertly maintaining independent arrangements, using his sister's Heavenly Fate Key identity as a countermeasure.
choices.visible_cost: Requires deceiving an entity who knows the complete truth of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain three days of respite while retaining core control over the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If Mo Xiansheng sees through the scheme, the consequences would be unthinkable

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment before finally nodding. "We'll do as you say. But I need to make some preparations first." His gaze fell upon Chen Nian. "Sister, are you willing to trust your brother this once?" Chen Nian nodded without hesitation. A slight smile curved Ye Qing's lips. "Very well, I'll return first to arrange the Demonic Path mist—to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, making your performance more authentic."

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng wants to make him a chess piece, but he refuses. Even if the Tianji Record must be sealed, he will preserve his final autonomy.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Mo Xiansheng's knowledge and unsealing support
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent identity, free from complete control by any party
choices.risk_hint: May face Mo Xiansheng's direct sanction after three days

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze instantly chilled. "Mo Xiansheng wants the Tianji Record? Then let him come take it." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "But before that, I want him to understand—on Chen Ji's chessboard, there has never been an option called 'certain defeat'." Ye Qing furrowed her brow, biting back words. But Chen Nian grasped Chen Ji's hand, expressing silent support.

choices.description: Have Chen Nian proactively negotiate with Mo Xiansheng as the Heavenly Fate Key, using her unique disruptive ability as negotiating leverage.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian will be exposed to immense danger
choices.visible_reward: If successful, it will completely shatter Mo Xiansheng's control structure
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may have set a trap targeting the Heavenly Fate Key

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Chen Nian, his gaze complex. After a moment, he sighed softly: "Alright." Just one word, yet heavy as a thousand jun. Chen Nian's eyes brightened. She stepped forward, her voice trembling yet firm: "Rest assured, Brother—I will let Mo Xiansheng know that the value of the Heavenly Fate Key far exceeds his imagination." Ye Qing glanced at Chen Nian meaningfully but said nothing.

Just then, sounds came from outside the door again—this time not knocking, but footsteps. Steady, powerful, carrying an imposing presence. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Where had he heard this gait before? Ye Qing's expression shifted as she instinctively positioned herself protectively in front of Chen Nian, whispering: "It's an envoy from the imperial court." Chen Ji's heart sank. The three-day deadline, the imperial envoy, Mo Xiansheng—these clues rapidly interwove in his mind, forming a chilling realization that sent a shiver down his spine.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." A low voice came from outside the door, carrying a familiar hoarseness. "This envoy has come to deliver the imperial court's final ultimatum." Chen Ji rose slowly, walking to the door but not opening it immediately. His hand pressed against the doorframe, knuckles white from tension. Mo Xiansheng's voice and the imperial envoy's voice were seventy to eighty percent similar. No, not just similar—they sounded like the same person. Fragments from the Tianji Record Fragment flashed through his mind, those deliberately obscured prophetic passages.

choice.prompt: The arrival of the imperial envoy disrupted Chen Ji's plans. How should he deal with this突如其来的变数?

choices.text: Open the door directly for confrontation
choices.description: Face the imperial envoy directly, appearing weak as a talentless disciple while secretly observing the opponent's weaknesses.
choices.visible_reward: See the imperial envoy's true face
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may be Mo Xiansheng himself

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and slowly opened the door. Standing outside was a middle-aged man in dark official robes, his countenance elegant, his gaze deep and unfathomable. The moment their eyes met, Chen Ji saw a flash of... familiarity in the envoy's eyes. This wasn't their first meeting. But he could be certain—this person had some connection to Mo Xiansheng that he had yet to unravel.

choices.description: Use feeling unwell as an excuse to temporarily avoid, buying time for Ye Qing to retreat first.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to understand the truth
choices.visible_reward: Buy time for arranging follow-up actions
choices.risk_hint: The imperial envoy may see through the delay tactic

text.content: Chen Ji gave Ye Qing a meaningful look, and she immediately understood, pulling Chen Nian toward the inner room. Chen Ji cleared his throat and spoke in a slightly hoarse voice: "Please forgive me, Your Excellency. I suffered a mishap during last night's cultivation and am bedridden..." Outside the door, there was a moment of silence before that low voice rang out again: "No matter. This envoy has come for one purpose only—the imperial court wants one person at the sect competition in three days."

Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. Sect competition? The imperial court wants one person? This information had never appeared in the Tianji Record—or rather, it had been deliberately erased. His fingers subtly touched the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve, trying to glimpse some heavenly secrets. However, those prophetic images that should have been clear were shrouded in mist, unclear and vague. "Chen Nian..." he murmured in his heart. She was right here, and her presence itself was the greatest interference. Could Mo Xiansheng's timing of her appearance be mere coincidence?

dialogue.content: "Brother." Chen Nian's voice came from the inner room, carrying a hint of异样: "I just sensed... Mo Xiansheng's aura. It's right outside this door." Chen Ji's heart lurched. He looked toward the door gap—the imperial envoy's figure still stood upright, motionless, like a statue. But Chen Nian's words would never be wrong. The Heavenly Fate Key's perception of things related to the Tianji Record was her innate talent.

text.content: Countless thoughts flashed through Chen Ji's mind like lightning. Three-day deadline, imperial envoy, Mo Xiansheng, sect competition—these seemingly unrelated fragments, under his superb logical deduction, gradually pieced together a terrifying picture. Mo Xiansheng and the imperial envoy were the same person? No, not exactly. More precisely... the imperial envoy was Mo Xiansheng's other identity, or rather, Mo Xiansheng's representative in the mortal world. He chose to personally visit in the guise of an envoy, delivering both a final ultimatum and a test.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, this envoy knows you are awake." The voice outside the door was calm without a ripple. "There are also things I wish to ask you face-to-face—about the Tianji Record, and about your... sister." The last two words were emphasized heavily, carrying some profound meaning. Chen Ji's hand slowly clenched into a fist. This old fox, he knows everything indeed. The trump cards he had exhausted every effort to hide seemed already exposed in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. But so what? The chess game hasn't reached its final move, victory or defeat remains uncertain.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng (imperial envoy) has already revealed Chen Nian's existence. How should Chen Ji break the deadlock?

choices.description: Since she can't be hidden anymore, might as well proactively expose her, using offense as defense.
choices.visible_reward: May disrupt Mo Xiansheng's predictions, seizing the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and yanked open the door. He stared directly into those deep eyes, even allowing a faint smile to curve his lips: 'Since Your Excellency knows everything, there is no point for Chen Ji to hide any longer—this is my sister, Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Key.' His voice was not loud, yet carried undeniable resolve. 'What does Your Excellency desire—her, or the Tianji Record?'

choices.description: Refuse to admit under any circumstances, making the other party fall into self-doubt.
choices.visible_reward: Buy time for Chen Nian to escape
choices.risk_hint: The other party is clearly well-prepared

text.content: Chen Ji wore an expression of feigned bewilderment, his brow creasing: 'Sister? Your Excellency must be joking. Chen Ji has been an orphan since childhood—where would a sister come from?' His acting was flawless, even his gaze carrying precisely calibrated confusion. Silence hung outside the door for several breaths before the Imperial Court emissary suddenly let out a soft laugh: 'Very well, very well. Chen Ji, your courage exceeds my expectations.' As his words fell, an invisible pressure descended, and Chen Ji's knees bent slightly.

choices.description: Directly question the other party's identity, forcing Mo Xiansheng to reveal his true form.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, it will completely break the deadlock
choices.risk_hint: The other party's strength is unfathomable

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly straightened, his gaze locking onto those bottomless eyes as he spoke word by word: 'Mo Xiansheng—or should I address you as the Imperial Court emissary? The three-day agreement, the Sect Competition, your meticulously orchestrated scheme—I am genuinely impressed.' The air seemed to crystallize for an instant. The Imperial Court emissary's expression finally shifted—a subtle upturn of his lips, a flicker of... appreciation in his eyes?

Chen Ji's heart plummeted. He knew what Ye Qing was worried about—once Chen Nian's identity as the Heavenly Fate Key was exposed, the entire Holy Sect would view her as a prize to be seized. Mo Xiansheng was powerful, certainly, but the Holy Sect's influence was even more formidable. More critically, Chen Nian was his only remaining family, and he would never gamble with her safety in a game of uncertain odds. 'Three days...' he murmured, 'That will be enough.' Ye Qing and Chen Nian both turned to him, awaiting his next words.

dialogue.content: The Imperial Court emissary's lips curved with a knowing smile: 'You maintain remarkable composure. Yet I find myself intrigued—confronted with such a predicament, what is your plan? Surrender the Tianji Record? Sacrifice your sister? Or...' He paused, his gaze sharp as a blade. 'Do you possess other hidden cards?' Chen Ji met his stare with unsettling tranquility: 'Your Excellency speaks truth. Before the final move on the board, everything remains possible.'

text.content: Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, standing at Chen Ji's side. Her gaze fell upon the Imperial Court emissary, a mocking smile curling her lips: 'Mo Xiansheng—or should I address you as the Imperial Court emissory? The three-day agreement, the Sect Competition, your meticulously orchestrated scheme—Chen Ji is genuinely impressed.' The emissary's eyes flickered slightly, clearly unprepared for Ye Qing to so directly tear through the veil. 'The Holy Sect's Saint Maiden of the Demonic Path—reputation well deserved.' His voice betrayed no pleasure or displeasure. 'Since you all know, I will speak plainly—Chen Ji must participate in the Sect Competition three days from now.'

'Sect Competition?' Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. 'What concern is that of mine?' The Imperial Court emissary smiled faintly, the expression carrying inexplicable depths: 'Because this time, the Imperial Court seeks to select one person—a person who will represent the Imperial Court in the Heavenly Dao Trial.' The words 'Heavenly Dao Trial' struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. The Tianji Record Fragment had mentioned this name before—the sole passage connecting the mortal realm to the immortal realm, and the key to finding Chen Nian and uncovering his father's death. Imperial Court emissary... Mo Xiansheng... everything, was aimed at the Heavenly Dao Trial.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's face darkened abruptly. She stepped forward, shielding Chen Ji: 'Mo Xiansheng, your appetite is enormous. The Heavenly Dao Trial nomination—three major sects have contested it for centuries without success, yet you speak as if it's already yours?' Her voice dripped with undisguised mockery. 'Or perhaps... you are not doing this for the Imperial Court at all, but for yourself?' The Imperial Court emissary fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed: 'The Saint Maiden is indeed intelligent. Correct, the Heavenly Dao Trial holds extraordinary significance for me—it is my sole chance to completely escape this fragmented soul state.'

text.content: 'Completely escape this fragmented soul state?' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. 'So your three-day agreement was a facade from the very beginning. What you truly need is not control over the Tianji Record, but a chess piece to help you pass the Heavenly Dao Trial.' He paused, a cold smile forming at the corner of his lips. 'And I, happen to meet all your conditions—atrash identity that draws no attention, the Tianji Record Fragment hiding profound secrets, and a sister who is the Heavenly Fate Key.' A flicker of appreciation crossed the Imperial Court emissary's eyes: 'You are smarter than I anticipated.'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian suddenly stepped out from Chen Ji's side, standing before the Imperial Court emissary. Her gaze was terrifyingly calm, as if examining an object: 'Mo Xiansheng, what you desire is to pass the Heavenly Dao Trial and escape your fragmented soul state. But have you considered—if the Heavenly Will detects my Heavenly Fate Key abilities, the first person it will erase is you?' The Imperial Court emissary's pupils contracted slightly. In that moment, Chen Nian's aura had completely transformed—no longer the delicate younger sister, but a strategist orchestrating from the shadows.

text.content: As the tension reached its peak, the Imperial Court emissary suddenly stepped back, his oppressive aura receding like an ebbing tide. His gaze shifted from Chen Ji to Chen Nian, and he let out a soft sigh: 'Very well. Since you all know, I will not hide anything. Chen Ji must participate in the Sect Competition three days from now—that is my condition. As for how you respond, that is your concern.' He turned to leave, then paused, glancing back at Chen Ji. 'By the way, there is one more thing to remind you—Ling Yuan already knows of Chen Nian's existence.' His figure vanished into the night.

Ling Yuan...' Chen Ji repeated the name softly, his gaze growing cold and sharp. The former Sect Master's name hung over him like a lingering specter, threading through every折磨 of this body's original owner. Tianqing Sect, his father's death, his废柴 persona—Ling Yuan's shadow lurked behind all of it. Now he had set his sights on Chen Nian, extinguishing the last trace of侥幸 in Chen Ji's heart. 'Three days.' He murmured. 'Within three days, all problems must be resolved.' Ye Qing walked to his side, asking softly: 'What do you plan to do?' Chen Ji offered no answer, only raising his eyes to the night sky beyond the window, his gaze flickering with complex light.
